ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: Band Instrument Diagnosis and Repair for Music Educators. This course will be taught to all students in lecture format from June 16 through June 26, and in small lab groups from June 27 through July 11. These lab groups will be completed in seven 2-hour sessions, to be arranged by the instructor. This four-week course is designed as an introductory class to offer music educators information and hands-on experience with diagnosing problems associated with woodwind and brass instruments. Minor instrument repair will also be addressed. All course participants will work directly with the equipment and instruments. This course may be considered as a music education elective. Course supplies: $100
